LLM-Assisted Analysis

✅ All 14 scenarios passed — new Vitals system added

Provider: deepseek · Model: deepseek-chat · Generated On: 2026-07-02T13:29:13+00:00 · Stage: success · Confidence: high

All 14 Webots integration scenarios passed (100% pass rate). This PR introduces the new `robonix-vitals` health monitoring system, including Soma health stream ingestion, component-tree normalization, threshold matching, and state-change push. The CI exercised existing capabilities (camera, lidar, explore, navigation, memory, speech, voiceprint, scene, executor builtins) and flow scenarios (fault recovery, object navigation, patrol observe). No regressions detected.

PR Changes

  • Added new system/vitals crate with gRPC health monitoring services (GetVitals, StreamVitals)
  • Added Soma health stream ingestion (StreamHealth) with threshold evaluation rules
  • Added mock Soma server with 5 scenarios (normal, ramp, fault, toggle, mixed) for development
  • Added hardware bridge subprocess support for Piper (CAN) and Koch (Dynamixel) arms
  • Added new IDL messages: SomaHealthSnapshot, ComponentStatus, ActuatorState, FaultState, PowerSourceState, SafetyState, VitalsSnapshot, BodyHealth, ComponentHealth, PowerState
  • Added new capability contracts: robonix/service/vitals/get, robonix/service/vitals/stream, robonix/system/soma/get_health, robonix/system/soma/health, robonix/primitive/health/state, robonix/primitive/health/stream
  • Updated Cargo.toml workspace members and Makefile build targets to include system/vitals
  • Updated Cargo.lock with new dependencies (defmt, env_logger, jiff, proc-macro-error2, portable-atomic-util, robonix-vitals)
  • Updated docs subproject commit

Test Result

  • 14/14 scenarios passed: builtin (fault_recovery_builtin, file_roundtrip, run_command), cap (camera_snapshot, explore_smoke, lidar_snapshot, mapping_save, memory_roundtrip, scene_object_fixture, speech_speak, voiceprint_list), flow (fault_recovery, object_navigation, patrol_observe). All leaf calls succeeded as expected, including expected failures (missing file, explore timeout, invalid memory save args).

Suggested Fix

  • No fix needed. Monitor the new Vitals system in future CI runs to ensure Soma ingestion and threshold evaluation work correctly with real hardware bridges.

Risks Or Watchouts

  • New Vitals system is not yet exercised in CI scenarios — no test covers the health monitoring pipeline
  • Hardware bridge subprocesses (piper_bridge.py, koch_bridge.py) require external SDKs not present in CI environment
  • Mock Soma scenarios are for development only; production behavior depends on real Soma implementation
  • TTL-based STALE detection is not yet implemented (noted in soma_ingest.rs TODO)
